verdict.rationale: The SDK offers session memory to persist conversation history across runs and a human-in-the-loop mechanism that pauses and resumes from a serializable RunState, and community evidence shows a Temporal-based durable-execution port of the SDK exists and behaves similarly to the original. However, there is no first-party documentation of native durability across process restarts/deploys (e.g., checkpointing mid-run state, automatic recovery), so it relies on external integrations like Temporal rather than a built-in mechanism. Missing for 10: native crash-recovery/checkpointing docs, first-party durable-execution integration guide, and independent verification of production reliability across deploys.
